subject.title: [Feature]: Channel Broker Phase 2A - broker conformance harness

question: Should OpenClaw create a new Channel Broker SDK and bundled broker conformance surface, or should shared channel behavior continue through the existing `channel-outbound` contracts?
rationale: The requested work creates a new cross-channel API/security/config boundary, and the linked implementation stack was closed because it crossed those boundaries without prior maintainer-approved design.

options.title: Approve a smaller broker design first
options.body: Define the SDK, config, security, and migration boundaries in a narrow design discussion, then implement only the conformance harness for that approved shape.

options.title: Extend channel-outbound instead
options.body: Use the current channel message lifecycle and proof helpers as the canonical contract and avoid creating a separate broker plugin/API for now.

options.title: Reject core broker work
options.body: Keep broker-style integrations outside core unless a concrete missing plugin API or maintainer-owned security requirement is identified.

recommendation.title: Approve a smaller broker design first
recommendation.body: Define the SDK, config, security, and migration boundaries in a narrow design discussion, then implement only the conformance harness for that approved shape.

likelyOwner.reason: This account made the live repository-member close decision on the linked broker stack and is therefore the clearest owner for the next product/API direction call.
